subject: Ariba invite stuck / PO number showing mismatch — Greenleaf Electronics
messages:
From: Sally Park <sally@greenleaf-electronics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ariba-support@ariba.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 08:18:00 -0400
Subject: Ariba invite pending + PO mismatch (Greenleaf)

Hi Jonas —

We accepted the Ariba supplier invite yesterday but the portal still shows our account in "Pending" status and requests the PO number for invoice 4491. We uploaded the signed W-9 (attached) but when we try to add PO-4491 the system returns "PO number not found for buyer RedWood Inc" (see screenshot sent to Ariba support). Can you help confirm the correct PO reference or the buyer-side index you expect?

A few details:
- Vendor: Greenleaf Electronics (EIN: 12-3456789)
- Our AP contact: sally@greenleaf-electronics.com
- Attached: Greenleaf_W9_Form_signed.pdf, copy of PO-4491

Ariba support opened INC-987654 but asked us to confirm the buyer-side PO id first. We're blocked to submit our first invoice. Appreciate any quick guidance — our finance team needs to bill this week.

Thanks,
Sally Park
Finance Manager
Greenleaf Electronics
[Attachment: Greenleaf_W9_Form_signed.pdf]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sally Park <sally@greenleaf-electronics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ariba Support <ariba-support@ariba.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Ariba invite pending + PO mismatch (Greenleaf)

Hi Sally — thanks for the details and the W-9. Short answer: we'll confirm the buyer-side PO mapping and route this to procurement ops to unblock you.

Karthik / Marissa — can you take ownership here? The vendor has uploaded the W-9 but Ariba reports "PO number not found" for PO-4491. Attached is Sally's PO copy. Please confirm whether Redwood issued PO-4491 under a different internal ref (some corporate POs use the project prefix RWD-4491) or whether this needs a manual link on the buyer side. If you need me to loop legal/IT for the Ariba mapping, say the word.

Sally — we'll come back with the internal PO lookup within the day. If it's helpful I can provide a direct contact at our AP to accept the invoice in the interim.

— Jonas
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO-4491.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba invite pending + PO mismatch (Greenleaf)

Quick update after checking our PO registry: the official buyer PO is RWD-4491 (internal). When vendors reference "PO-4491" without the RWD- prefix Ariba sometimes fails to reconcile automatically. I can add a manual mapping in the Ariba buyer portal but I need the vendor's Ariba supplier ID (not just the email). Sally — can you share the supplier ID shown in your Ariba dashboard? If you don't have it I can ask Ariba support to surface it from the ticket.

Also: I flagged that W-9 is valid and matches our vendor onboarding checklist, so once mapping is added the vendor should move to Active and be able to submit the invoice. Marissa, I'll proceed to add the manual mapping after we get the supplier ID.

Thanks,
Karthik
Procurement Ops, Redwood

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sally Park <sally@greenleaf-electronics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ariba Support <ariba-support@ariba.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba invite pending + PO mismatch (Greenleaf)

Hi Sally —

Thanks for sending the W-9. I went into the buyer portal and located your entry. Your supplier ID is SL-77312 (it's in the onboarding summary). I added a manual mapping for vendor reference "PO-4491" -> Redwood internal RWD-4491 and requested Ariba to re-run reconciliation. You should receive an updated invite status shortly.

I've also sent you a short DocuSign for a standard Redwood vendor agreement (we request signature before first invoice for terms and remittance address). Please sign so we can push the account to Active; the DocuSign link is below.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/recipient/view?env=na1&res=0A1B2C3D

If anything still looks off after you accept the mapping let me know and I'll escalate with Ariba.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf]

From: Sally Park <sally@greenleaf-electronics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba invite pending + PO mismatch (Greenleaf)

Hi Marissa / team —

Confirmed — we got the mapping and our account is now Active in Ariba. I signed the DocuSign and submitted invoice INV-10033 against PO-4491 (Ariba accepted it). Thank you all for the quick turnaround — appreciate Karthik adding the manual mapping and Marissa for the DocuSign.

If you want I can send a short note to my AP team to confirm Redwood's remittance details are correct, but from our side everything looks good.

Thanks,
Sally
Finance Manager
Greenleaf Electronics
